name: webconsulting/desiderio
description: Desiderio — shadcn/ui-inspired Fluid 5 component library, 244 Desiderio Content Blocks, and theme layer for TYPO3 14

suggest.georgringer/news: Optional. Drives the shadcn-styled News templates and the DesiderioNews backend layout. Thank you, Georg Ringer.
suggest.in2code/powermail: Optional. Drives the shadcn-styled Powermail templates and demo form seeder. Thank you, in2code.
suggest.studiomitte/friendlycaptcha: Optional. Protects the bundled TYPO3 Form Framework and Powermail lab forms with Friendly Captcha. For TYPO3 14 install the fork: add the VCS repository https://github.com/dirnbauer/friendlycaptcha-typo3 and require studiomitte/friendlycaptcha:^14.0@dev. Without it the captcha element renders an inert placeholder and validation passes. Thank you, Studio Mitte.
suggest.apache-solr-for-typo3/solr: Optional. Drives the shadcn-styled Solr search templates. Thank you to dkd Internet Service GmbH and the TYPO3-Solr team.
suggest.t3g/blog: Optional. Drives the shadcn-styled t3g/blog overrides shipped under webconsulting/desiderio-blog. Thank you, TYPO3 GmbH.
suggest.netresearch/nr-llm: Optional. Netresearch's AI foundation for TYPO3 — the shared LLM provider layer behind the agentic features shown in the styleguide, alongside nr-mcp-agent, nr-vault and t3-cowriter. Thank you, Netresearch DTT GmbH.
